inputs.body:
@{replace(
  replace(
    replace(
      variables('BackupInstanceTrendFunction'),
      concat('-', string(parameters('timeRangeInDays')), ',startofday(now())'),
      '-35,startofday(now())'
    ),
    concat('let _AggregationType = ', parameters('aggregationType'), ';'),
    'let _AggregationType = "Daily";'
  ),
  'iff(isempty(StorageConsumedInMBs), todouble(0), StorageConsumedInMBs)',
  'todouble(StorageConsumedInMBs)'
)}
| where VaultType =~ "Microsoft.RecoveryServices/vaults"
| extend
    SnapshotDay = startofday(TimeGenerated),
    StorageMB = todouble(VaultStore_StorageConsumptionInMBs)
| where isnotnull(StorageMB)
| where
    SnapshotDay >= startofmonth(now())
    and SnapshotDay < startofday(now())
| summarize
    StorageGB = sum(StorageMB) / 1024.0
    by SnapshotDay, VaultResourceId, VaultName
| extend
    BaselineDay = SnapshotDay,
    LatestDay = SnapshotDay,
    BaselineStorageGB = StorageGB,
    LatestStorageGB = StorageGB
| summarize
    arg_min(BaselineDay, BaselineStorageGB),
    arg_max(LatestDay, LatestStorageGB)
    by VaultResourceId, VaultName
| extend
    ChangeGB = LatestStorageGB - BaselineStorageGB
| extend
    ChangePercent = iff(
        BaselineStorageGB > 0,
        100.0 * ChangeGB / BaselineStorageGB,
        real(null)
    )
| order by VaultName asc
| project
    ['Recovery Services Vault'] =
        iff(isempty(VaultName), VaultResourceId, VaultName),
    ['Month start observed date'] =
        format_datetime(BaselineDay, 'yyyy-MM-dd'),
    ['Storage at month start (GB)'] =
        tostring(round(BaselineStorageGB, 2)),
    ['Latest observed date'] =
        format_datetime(LatestDay, 'yyyy-MM-dd'),
    ['Latest storage used (GB)'] =
        tostring(round(LatestStorageGB, 2)),
    ['Change since month start (GB)'] =
        strcat(
            iff(ChangeGB > 0, '+', ''),
            tostring(round(ChangeGB, 2))
        ),
    ['Change since month start (%)'] =
        iff(
            BaselineStorageGB > 0,
            strcat(
                iff(ChangePercent > 0, '+', ''),
                tostring(round(ChangePercent, 2)),
                '%'
            ),
            'N/A — zero baseline'
        )

inputs.body:
@{replace(
  replace(
    variables('BackupInstanceTrendFunction'),
    concat('-', string(parameters('timeRangeInDays')), ',startofday(now())'),
    '-31,startofday(now())'
  ),
  concat('let _AggregationType = ', parameters('aggregationType'), ';'),
  'let _AggregationType = "Daily";'
)}
| summarize TotalCloudBackupStorageGB =
    sum(todouble(VaultStore_StorageConsumptionInMBs)) / 1024
    by Date = startofday(TimeGenerated),
       RecoveryServicesVault =
           iff(isempty(VaultName), "(unnamed vault)", VaultName)
| where Date > _RangeStart
| project
    Date,
    RecoveryServicesVault,
    ['Cloud backup storage used (GB)'] =
        round(TotalCloudBackupStorageGB, 2)
| order by Date asc

@{variables('JobFunction')}
// query to transform function output
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, Status) by UniqueId
| summarize count(Status) by Status, bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| project TimeGenerated, count_Status,
    JobStatus = (
        iff(
            Status == "Completed",
            "Succeeded",
            iff(
                Status == "CompletedWithWarnings",
                "SucceededWithWarnings",
                Status
            )
        )
    )
| sort by TimeGenerated asc

inputs.body:
@{variables('BillingGroupFunction')}
|  extend name_array = split(Name,";")
|  extend name_arraylen = array_length(name_array)
| project BilledEntity=FriendlyName, BilledEntityResourceGroup=iff(name_arraylen == 3, name_array[(name_arraylen-2)], "(none)"), BilledEntityType=Type, BackupSolution, ProtectedInstances=todouble(parse_json(ExtendedProperties).ProtectedInstanceCount), CloudStorage=VaultStore_StorageConsumptionInMBs/1024, StorageReplicationType=VaultStore_StorageReplicationType, Vault=VaultResourceId, VaultResourceGroup=split(split(tolower(VaultResourceId), '/resourcegroups/')[1],'/')[0], Subscription=VaultSubscriptionId

@{variables('JobFunction')}
| where OperationCategory == "Backup"
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by VaultResourceId, UniqueId
| extend
    IsSuccessful = Status in ("Completed", "CompletedWithWarnings"),
    IsAzureFiles = DatasourceType =~ "Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts/fileServices/shares"
| summarize
    TotalJobs = count(),
    SuccessfulJobs = countif(IsSuccessful),
    FailedJobs = countif(Status == "Failed"),
    WarningJobs = countif(Status == "CompletedWithWarnings"),
    CancelledJobs = countif(Status in ("Cancelled", "Canceled")),
    OtherJobs = countif(Status !in (
        "Completed", "CompletedWithWarnings", "Failed", "Cancelled", "Canceled"
    )),
    FilesJobs = countif(IsAzureFiles),
    FilesSuccessful = countif(IsAzureFiles and IsSuccessful),
    FilesFailed = countif(IsAzureFiles and Status == "Failed")
| extend
    OverallResult = iff(
        TotalJobs == 0,
        "No backup job data returned",
        strcat(SuccessfulJobs, " of ", TotalJobs, " (",
            round(100.0 * SuccessfulJobs / TotalJobs, 2), "%)")
    ),
    FilesResult = iff(
        FilesJobs == 0,
        "No Azure Files backup job data returned",
        strcat(FilesSuccessful, " of ", FilesJobs, " (",
            round(100.0 * FilesSuccessful / FilesJobs, 2), "%)")
    )
| extend SummaryRows = pack_array(
    bag_pack("Metric", "Reporting period (UTC)", "Result",
        strcat(format_datetime(_RangeStart, "yyyy-MM-dd"), " to ",
            format_datetime(_RangeEnd - 1d, "yyyy-MM-dd"))),
    bag_pack("Metric", "Successful backup jobs — includes warnings", "Result", OverallResult),
    bag_pack("Metric", "Failed backup jobs", "Result", tostring(FailedJobs)),
    bag_pack("Metric", "Jobs completed with warnings", "Result", tostring(WarningJobs)),
    bag_pack("Metric", "Cancelled backup jobs", "Result", tostring(CancelledJobs)),
    bag_pack("Metric", "Jobs with other reported statuses", "Result", tostring(OtherJobs)),
    bag_pack("Metric", "Successful Azure Files jobs — includes warnings", "Result", FilesResult),
    bag_pack("Metric", "Failed Azure Files backup jobs", "Result", tostring(FilesFailed))
)
| mv-expand with_itemindex=RowOrder SummaryRows
| order by RowOrder asc
| project
    Metric = tostring(SummaryRows.Metric),
    Result = tostring(SummaryRows.Result)

Compose-PolicyAssignmentsQuery.inputs:
recoveryservicesresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.recoveryservices/vaults/backupfabrics/protectioncontainers/protecteditems'
| extend System = tostring(properties.friendlyName), Vault = tostring(split(id, '/')[8]), Policy = tostring(properties.policyName), ProtectionState = tostring(properties.protectionState), policyId = tolower(tostring(properties.policyId)), srcId = tolower(tostring(properties.sourceResourceId))
| join kind=leftouter (
    recoveryservicesresources
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.recoveryservices/vaults/backuppolicies'
    | extend sp = properties.schedulePolicy, rp = properties.retentionPolicy
    | extend policyId = tolower(id),
             Frequency = tostring(sp.scheduleRunFrequency),
             IntervalHours = tostring(sp.hourlySchedule.interval),
             RunTime = substring(coalesce(tostring(sp.hourlySchedule.scheduleWindowStartTime), tostring(sp.dailySchedule.scheduleRunTimes[0]), tostring(sp.weeklySchedule.scheduleRunTimes[0]), tostring(sp.scheduleRunTimes[0])), 11, 5),
             RunDays = strcat_array(coalesce(sp.weeklySchedule.scheduleRunDays, sp.scheduleRunDays), ', '),
             TimeZone = tostring(properties.timeZone),
             InstantRestore = iff(isnull(properties.instantRpRetentionRangeInDays), '', strcat(tostring(properties.instantRpRetentionRangeInDays), ' Days')),
             Daily = iff(isnull(rp.dailySchedule), '', strcat(tostring(rp.dailySchedule.retentionDuration['count']), ' ', tostring(rp.dailySchedule.retentionDuration.durationType))),
             Weekly = iff(isnull(rp.weeklySchedule), '', strcat(tostring(rp.weeklySchedule.retentionDuration['count']), ' ', tostring(rp.weeklySchedule.retentionDuration.durationType))),
             Monthly = iff(isnull(rp.monthlySchedule), '', strcat(tostring(rp.monthlySchedule.retentionDuration['count']), ' ', tostring(rp.monthlySchedule.retentionDuration.durationType))),
             Yearly = iff(isnull(rp.yearlySchedule), '', strcat(tostring(rp.yearlySchedule.retentionDuration['count']), ' ', tostring(rp.yearlySchedule.retentionDuration.durationType)))
    | project policyId, Frequency, IntervalHours, RunTime, RunDays, TimeZone, InstantRestore, Daily, Weekly, Monthly, Yearly
) on policyId
| join kind=leftouter (
    resources
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines'
    | project srcId = tolower(id), BackupTypeTag = tostring(tags['BackupType'])
) on srcId
| extend Policy = iff(isempty(Policy), strcat('No policy assigned (', ProtectionState, ')'), Policy)
| order by Policy asc, System asc
| project System, BackupTypeTag, Vault, Policy, ProtectionState, Frequency, IntervalHours, RunTime, RunDays, TimeZone, InstantRestore, Daily, Weekly, Monthly, Yearly

| join kind=leftouter (

    | where type =~ 'microsoft.recoveryservices/vaults/backuppolicies'
    | extend sp = properties.schedulePolicy, rp = properties.retentionPolicy
    | extend policyId = tolower(id),
             Frequency = tostring(sp.scheduleRunFrequency),
             IntervalHours = tostring(sp.hourlySchedule.interval),
             RunTime = substring(coalesce(tostring(sp.hourlySchedule.scheduleWindowStartTime), tostring(sp.dailySchedule.scheduleRunTimes[0]), tostring(sp.weeklySchedule.scheduleRunTimes[0]), tostring(sp.scheduleRunTimes[0])), 11, 5),
             RunDays = strcat_array(coalesce(sp.weeklySchedule.scheduleRunDays, sp.scheduleRunDays), ', '),
             TimeZone = tostring(properties.timeZone),
             InstantRestore = iff(isnull(properties.instantRpRetentionRangeInDays), '', strcat(tostring(properties.instantRpRetentionRangeInDays), ' Days')),
             Daily = iff(isnull(rp.dailySchedule), '', strcat(tostring(rp.dailySchedule.retentionDuration['count']), ' ', tostring(rp.dailySchedule.retentionDuration.durationType))),
             Weekly = iff(isnull(rp.weeklySchedule), '', strcat(tostring(rp.weeklySchedule.retentionDuration['count']), ' ', tostring(rp.weeklySchedule.retentionDuration.durationType))),
             Monthly = iff(isnull(rp.monthlySchedule), '', strcat(tostring(rp.monthlySchedule.retentionDuration['count']), ' ', tostring(rp.monthlySchedule.retentionDuration.durationType))),
             Yearly = iff(isnull(rp.yearlySchedule), '', strcat(tostring(rp.yearlySchedule.retentionDuration['count']), ' ', tostring(rp.yearlySchedule.retentionDuration.durationType)))
    | project policyId, Frequency, IntervalHours, RunTime, RunDays, TimeZone, InstantRestore, Daily, Weekly, Monthly, Yearly

| join kind=leftouter (
    resources
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines'
    | project srcId = tolower(id), BackupTypeTag = tostring(tags['BackupType'])
) on srcId
| extend Policy = iff(isempty(Policy), strcat('No policy assigned (', ProtectionState, ')'), Policy)
| summarize SystemCount = count() by Policy, Frequency, IntervalHours, RunTime, RunDays, TimeZone, InstantRestore, Daily, Weekly, Monthly, Yearly

Compose-PostgresQuery.inputs:
recoveryservicesresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.dataprotection/backupvaults/backupinstances'
| extend Server = tostring(properties.friendlyName), Vault = tostring(split(id, '/')[8]), State = tostring(properties.currentProtectionState), policyId = tolower(tostring(properties.policyInfo.policyId)), srcId = tolower(tostring(properties.dataSourceInfo.resourceID))
| join kind=leftouter (
    recoveryservicesresources
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.dataprotection/backupvaults/backuppolicies'
    | extend policyId = tolower(id), Policy = name
    | mv-expand r = properties.policyRules
    | extend ObjType = tostring(r.objectType), RuleName = tostring(r.name), Dur = tostring(r.lifecycles[0].deleteAfter.duration), Interval = tostring(r.trigger.schedule.repeatingTimeIntervals[0]), TZ = tostring(r.trigger.schedule.timeZone)
    | extend Num = substring(Dur, 1, strlen(Dur) - 2), Unit = substring(Dur, strlen(Dur) - 1, 1)
    | extend RetText = strcat(RuleName, ' ', Num, ' ', case(Unit == 'D', 'days', Unit == 'W', 'weeks', Unit == 'M', 'months', Unit == 'Y', 'years', Unit))
    | extend Freq = case(Interval endswith 'P1D', 'Daily', Interval endswith 'P1W', 'Weekly', 'Custom')
    | extend SchedText = strcat(Freq, ' at ', substring(tostring(split(Interval, '/')[1]), 11, 5))
    | summarize FreqL = make_list_if(Freq, ObjType == 'AzureBackupRule'), SchedL = make_list_if(SchedText, ObjType == 'AzureBackupRule'), TZL = make_list_if(TZ, ObjType == 'AzureBackupRule'), RetL = make_list_if(RetText, ObjType == 'AzureRetentionRule') by policyId, Policy
    | project policyId, Policy, BackupSchedule = strcat(tostring(SchedL[0]), iff(isempty(tostring(TZL[0])), '', strcat(' (', tostring(TZL[0]), ')'))), LongTermRetention = replace_string(strcat_array(RetL, ', '), 'Default ', strcat(tostring(FreqL[0]), ' '))
) on policyId
| join kind=leftouter (
    resources
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.dbforpostgresql/flexibleservers'
    | project srcId = tolower(id), PITR = tostring(properties.backup.backupRetentionDays), Geo = tostring(properties.backup.geoRedundantBackup)
) on srcId
| extend Status = case(State == 'ProtectionConfigured', 'Protected', State == 'ProtectionStopped', 'Protection stopped', State),
         PointInTimeRestore = iff(isempty(PITR), 'N/A', strcat(PITR, ' days')),
         GeoRedundant = iff(Geo =~ 'Enabled', 'Yes', 'No')
| order by Server asc
| project Server, Vault, Policy, Status, BackupSchedule, LongTermRetention, PointInTimeRestore, GeoRedundant

Compose-EstateRsvQuery.inputs:
recoveryservicesresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.recoveryservices/vaults/backupfabrics/protectioncontainers/protecteditems'
| extend Workload = tostring(properties.workloadType), srcId = tolower(tostring(properties.sourceResourceId))
| join kind=leftouter (resources | project srcId = tolower(id), Exists = 1) on srcId
| extend WorkloadName = case(Workload =~ 'VM', 'Azure virtual machines', Workload contains 'PostgreSQL', 'PostgreSQL servers', Workload =~ 'AzureFileShare', 'Azure Files shares', Workload =~ 'SQLDataBase', 'SQL Server in VMs', Workload contains 'blobServices', 'Blob storage accounts', Workload)
| summarize Protected = countif(Exists == 1), Stale = countif(isnull(Exists)) by WorkloadName

| join kind=leftouter (resources | project srcId = tolower(id), Exists = 1) on srcId
| extend WorkloadName = case(Workload =~ 'VM', 'Azure virtual machines', Workload contains 'PostgreSQL', 'PostgreSQL servers', Workload =~ 'AzureFileShare', 'Azure Files shares', Workload =~ 'SQLDataBase', 'SQL Server in VMs', Workload contains 'blobServices', 'Blob storage accounts', Workload)
| summarize Protected = countif(Exists == 1), Stale = countif(isnull(Exists)) by WorkloadName

Compose-VaultsQuery.inputs:
resources
| where type in~ ('microsoft.recoveryservices/vaults', 'microsoft.dataprotection/backupvaults')
| extend VaultId = tolower(id), IsRSV = type =~ 'microsoft.recoveryservices/vaults'
| extend RedundancyRaw = coalesce(tostring(properties.redundancySettings.standardTierStorageRedundancy), tostring(properties.storageSettings[0].type)),
         ImmutabilityRaw = tostring(properties.securitySettings.immutabilitySettings.state),
         SoftDeleteRaw = coalesce(tostring(properties.securitySettings.softDeleteSettings.softDeleteState), tostring(properties.securitySettings.softDeleteSettings.state)),
         CrrRaw = coalesce(tostring(properties.redundancySettings.crossRegionRestore), tostring(properties.featureSettings.crossRegionRestoreSettings.state))
| join kind=leftouter (resourcecontainers | where type =~ 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions' | project subscriptionId, Subscription = name) on subscriptionId
| extend VaultType = iff(IsRSV, 'Recovery Services', 'Backup vault'),
         Redundancy = case(RedundancyRaw =~ 'GeoRedundant', 'GRS', RedundancyRaw =~ 'LocallyRedundant', 'LRS', RedundancyRaw =~ 'ZoneRedundant', 'ZRS', isempty(RedundancyRaw), 'N/A', RedundancyRaw),
         Immutability = case(ImmutabilityRaw =~ 'Unlocked', 'Enabled', ImmutabilityRaw =~ 'Locked', 'Enabled (locked)', isempty(ImmutabilityRaw) or ImmutabilityRaw =~ 'Disabled', 'Disabled', ImmutabilityRaw),
         SoftDelete = case(SoftDeleteRaw =~ 'AlwaysON', 'Always on', isempty(SoftDeleteRaw), 'N/A', SoftDeleteRaw),
         CrossRegionRestore = case(CrrRaw =~ 'true', 'Enabled', CrrRaw =~ 'false', 'Disabled', isempty(CrrRaw), 'N/A', CrrRaw)
| order by IsRSV desc, name asc
| project VaultId, Vault = name, VaultType, Subscription, Location = location, Redundancy, Immutability, SoftDelete, CrossRegionRestore

Compose-VaultPoliciesQuery.inputs:
recoveryservicesresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.recoveryservices/vaults/backuppolicies' and tostring(properties.backupManagementType) == 'AzureIaasVM' and name startswith 'Tier-'
| extend VaultId = tostring(split(tolower(id), '/backuppolicies/')[0]), FP = strcat(tostring(properties.schedulePolicy.scheduleRunFrequency), '|', tostring(properties.schedulePolicy.hourlySchedule.interval), '|', tostring(properties.schedulePolicy.hourlySchedule.scheduleWindowDuration), '|', substring(coalesce(tostring(properties.schedulePolicy.hourlySchedule.scheduleWindowStartTime), tostring(properties.schedulePolicy.dailySchedule.scheduleRunTimes[0]), tostring(properties.schedulePolicy.weeklySchedule.scheduleRunTimes[0]), tostring(properties.schedulePolicy.scheduleRunTimes[0])), 11, 5), '|', tostring(coalesce(properties.schedulePolicy.weeklySchedule.scheduleRunDays, properties.schedulePolicy.scheduleRunDays)), '|', tostring(properties.timeZone), '|', tostring(properties.instantRpRetentionRangeInDays), '|', tostring(properties.retentionPolicy.dailySchedule.retentionDuration['count']), '|', tostring(properties.retentionPolicy.weeklySchedule.retentionDuration['count']), '|', tostring(properties.retentionPolicy.monthlySchedule.retentionDuration['count']), '|', tostring(properties.retentionPolicy.yearlySchedule.retentionDuration['count']))
| join kind=leftouter (
    recoveryservicesresources
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.recoveryservices/vaults/backuppolicies' and tostring(properties.backupManagementType) == 'AzureIaasVM' and name startswith 'Tier-'
    | extend FP = strcat(tostring(properties.schedulePolicy.scheduleRunFrequency), '|', tostring(properties.schedulePolicy.hourlySchedule.interval), '|', tostring(properties.schedulePolicy.hourlySchedule.scheduleWindowDuration), '|', substring(coalesce(tostring(properties.schedulePolicy.hourlySchedule.scheduleWindowStartTime), tostring(properties.schedulePolicy.dailySchedule.scheduleRunTimes[0]), tostring(properties.schedulePolicy.weeklySchedule.scheduleRunTimes[0]), tostring(properties.schedulePolicy.scheduleRunTimes[0])), 11, 5), '|', tostring(coalesce(properties.schedulePolicy.weeklySchedule.scheduleRunDays, properties.schedulePolicy.scheduleRunDays)), '|', tostring(properties.timeZone), '|', tostring(properties.instantRpRetentionRangeInDays), '|', tostring(properties.retentionPolicy.dailySchedule.retentionDuration['count']), '|', tostring(properties.retentionPolicy.weeklySchedule.retentionDuration['count']), '|', tostring(properties.retentionPolicy.monthlySchedule.retentionDuration['count']), '|', tostring(properties.retentionPolicy.yearlySchedule.retentionDuration['count']))
    | summarize n = count() by name, FP
    | summarize arg_max(n, FP) by name
    | project name, MajorityFP = FP
) on name
| summarize TierPolicies = make_set(name), Differs = make_set_if(name, FP != MajorityFP) by VaultId

inputs.body:
@{replace(
  replace(
    replace(
      variables('BackupInstanceTrendFunction'),
      concat('-', string(parameters('timeRangeInDays')), ',startofday(now())'),
      '-35,startofday(now())'
    ),
    concat('let _AggregationType = ', parameters('aggregationType'), ';'),
    'let _AggregationType = "Daily";'
  ),
  'iff(isempty(StorageConsumedInMBs), todouble(0), StorageConsumedInMBs)',
  'todouble(StorageConsumedInMBs)'
)}
| where VaultType =~ "Microsoft.RecoveryServices/vaults"
| extend
    SnapshotDay = startofday(TimeGenerated),
    StorageMB = todouble(VaultStore_StorageConsumptionInMBs)
| where isnotnull(StorageMB)
| where
    SnapshotDay >= startofmonth(now())
    and SnapshotDay < startofday(now())
| summarize
    StorageGB = sum(StorageMB) / 1024.0
    by SnapshotDay, VaultResourceId, VaultName
| extend
    BaselineDay = SnapshotDay,
    LatestDay = SnapshotDay,
    BaselineStorageGB = StorageGB,
    LatestStorageGB = StorageGB
| summarize
    arg_min(BaselineDay, BaselineStorageGB),
    arg_max(LatestDay, LatestStorageGB)
    by VaultResourceId, VaultName
| extend
    ChangeGB = LatestStorageGB - BaselineStorageGB
| extend
    ChangePercent = iff(
        BaselineStorageGB > 0,
        100.0 * ChangeGB / BaselineStorageGB,
        real(null)
    )
| order by VaultName asc
| project
    ['Recovery Services Vault'] =
        iff(isempty(VaultName), VaultResourceId, VaultName),
    ['Month start observed date'] =
        format_datetime(BaselineDay, 'yyyy-MM-dd'),
    ['Storage at month start (GB)'] =
        tostring(round(BaselineStorageGB, 2)),
    ['Latest observed date'] =
        format_datetime(LatestDay, 'yyyy-MM-dd'),
    ['Latest storage used (GB)'] =
        tostring(round(LatestStorageGB, 2)),
    ['Change since month start (GB)'] =
        strcat(
            iff(ChangeGB > 0, '+', ''),
            tostring(round(ChangeGB, 2))
        ),
    ['Change since month start (%)'] =
        iff(
            BaselineStorageGB > 0,
            strcat(
                iff(ChangePercent > 0, '+', ''),
                tostring(round(ChangePercent, 2)),
                '%'
            ),
            'N/A — zero baseline'
        )
